newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed to weak on Tuesday amid squaring of positions on settlement day, dealers said.
"Most players would like to square out of the market," a dealer at a foreign brokerage house said. He said there would be some uncertainty in the market ahead of the June 14 budget.

On Monday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 16.14 points, or 1.04 percent, to end at 1,531.81. Losers led gainers 208 to 60. Turnover rose to 57 million shares from 48 million in the previous session.
